question: OYO partnered with the Jammu and Kashmir administration to launch a rural tourism initiative. What this initiative is called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Crown of Incredible India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The **Jammu and Kashmir government** and the hospitality technology **company OYO** collaborated to introduce the** "Crown of Incredible India"** rural tourism project throughout the Union Territory.
 
• It intends to revive the** struggling tourism sector** and encourage **young people in J&K to launch** their own businesses.
 
• In accordance with this, OYO will collaborate with the **Center's "Mission Youth" initiative.**
 
• In order to encourage** entrepreneurship and generate **prospects for self-employment, it plans to open** homestays in 75 communities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** first floating financial literacy camp** in India was held as part of the** "Niveshak Didi" initiative's** inauguration in **Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir.**
 
• Around Srinagar's renowned Dal Lake, it was **conducted among local locals.**
 
• From a Shikara,** Niveshak Didi **conducted the** financial literacy class** in the indigenous Kashmiri language.
